item.title: How to pre-render Angular pages
item.description: Pre-rendering generates static HTML for your Angular pages at build time, providing instant page loads and perfect SEO without requiring a Node.js server. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve implemented prerendering for Angular applications. The most efficient approach is using Angular Universal’s built-in prerender builder to generate static pages during the build process. This method combines the benefits of SSR with the simplicity of static hosting.
